falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes above 5,200 on at least 3 consecutive trading days within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a strong bullish trend, contradicting the current HOLD signal and suggesting the market is not in a bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 14-day moving average of the VIX volatility index drops below 18
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant drop in volatility would suggest reduced fear and uncertainty in the market, which would invalidate the current HOLD signal by indicating a more stable and potentially bullish environment.

falsification_conditions.condition: The price of gold (XAU/USD) rises above $2,150 per ounce within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp increase in gold prices would signal a flight to safety, contradicting the assumption of a market bottom and suggesting ongoing economic or geopolitical stress, which would invalidate the current HOLD signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
